1. Set the slide to 16:9 with a white #FFFFFF background and sans-serif type.
2. Place the top worked-example panel: white rectangle with a thin black #000000 border at x 5%-73%, y 6%-33%.
3. Inside the panel on the left, place black text 'Initial' at x 6%-34%, y 7%-10%.
4. Below that label, place a table at x 6%-34%, y 11%-31% with blue #0000FF column headers x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ x₅ x₆; black #000000 data rows (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6), (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6), (1)(1)(1)(4)(5)(6); and class row C₁ C₁ C₁ C₂ C₂ C₂ with C₁ in red #D8262C and C₂ in blue #0000FF. Enclose every entry in parentheses.
5. Inside the panel center, place black text 'Initial W = [4; -2; -2]' at x 36%-54%, y 9%-14% with W underlined.
6. Inside the panel center below that text, place red #D8262C text 'Step η = 2' at x 36%-54%, y 16%-21%.
7. Inside the panel right, place black label 'Check classes of' at x 56%-72%, y 8%-12%.
8. Below that label, place a 2×3 table at x 56%-72%, y 13%-31% with blue #0000FF column headers Z₁ Z₁ Z₁ and black rows (0)(7)(3) and (0)(6)(2), entries in parentheses.
9. Place the legend text at x 17%-65%, y 34%-39%: 'C₁ positive, C₂ negative, Zero is unaccepted', with C₁ red #D8262C, C₂ blue #0000FF, and the remaining words black #000000; add a thin black pointer from the check-classes matrix down to 'Zero is unaccepted'.
10. Place the slide-number marker: yellow #FFFF00 circle at x 83%-92%, y 7%-18% containing black text '45'.
11. Place the augmented-vector title text 'Ugmented Vectors (from Top)' in black at x 4%-33%, y 41%-45%.
12. Below that title, place a table at x 4%-33%, y 46%-66% with blue #0000FF headers x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ x₅ x₆; four black vector rows (1)(1)(1)(1)(1)(1), (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6), (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6), (1)(1)(1)(4)(5)(6); and class row C₁ C₁ C₁ C₂ C₂ C₂ with C₁ red #D8262C and C₂ blue #0000FF; entries in parentheses.
13. Place the iteration badge: red #D8262C filled rectangle at x 4%-19%, y 69%-79% with centered white #FFFFFF bold text 'Iteration 4'.
14. Place the stop box: white #FFFFFF rectangle with red #D8262C border at x 4%-31%, y 82%-97%; first line black 'No change in W' with W underlined, second line red #FF0000 italic 'Stop Iterations'.
15. Place the calculation panel at x 35%-99%, y 41%-97% on a white background with six equal rows separated by light gray #D9D9D9 horizontal rules. In rows 1-6, place black text with W underlined and x subscripts: 'd(x₁) = [1 1 1; -4; 0] = 10 ⇒ Keep same Weight W = [14; -4; 0]', 'd(x₂) = [1 1 2; -4; 0] = -4 ⇒ Keep same Weight W = [14; -4; 0]', 'd(x₃) = [1 1 2; -4; 0] = 10 ⇒ Keep same Weight W = [14; -4; 0]', 'd(x₄) = [1 5 4; -4; 0] = -6 ⇒ Keep same Weight W = [14; -4; 0]', 'd(x₅) = [1 6 5; -4; 0] = -10 ⇒ Keep same Weight W = [14; -4; 0]', 'd(x₆) = [1 6 6; -4; 0] = -112 ⇒ Keep same Weight W = [14; -4; 0]'.
16. Leave the slide fully revealed with no animation.
